_: DERIVED — written by node tools/art-manifest.mjs --write, never by a hand. One entry per asset id (the runtime `assets/…` path, or a `common` pack path: fonts, licenses/OFL.txt, music/, map-detail/).

tiers.placeholder: no file: src/ui/assets.js draws the style guide recipe from the id (SPEC §2.4)
tiers.light: assets-mobile/ — the dev/test tier and the mobile edition's art
tiers.high: assets/ — full resolution; release/main builds and the Local high-res setting
tiers.common: one file for every tier: assets/fonts/ (the fonts), licenses/OFL.txt (from asset-data/fonts/OFL.txt), music/ and map-detail/
